briefdescription.para: gtest coverage for the legacy RingQQ rational ring (globalQQ).

detaileddescription.para: Specialises RingTest.hpp's getElement<RingQQ> with the deterministic [-25, 24] integer prefix followed by random rationals drawn from rawRandomQQ(maxH) with maxH = 10^11; the gmp_QQ result feeds through R.from_rational so any canonicalisation bugs surface in the test loop. Standard arithmetic and identity assertions run against globalQQ the engine's shared RingQQ instance and double as a regression check on aring-glue.hpp, which threads the modern ARingQQ* backends back into the legacy Ring surface the interpreter still uses.

Companion to RingZZTest.cpp, RingZZpTest.cpp, RingRRRTest.cpp, RingCCCTest.cpp, and RingTowerTest.cpp (all under the file-ring-tests markdown). Cross-checks against the aring-side ARingQQGmpTest.cpp / ARingQQFlintTest.cpp keep the two interfaces in sync.
